events.body:
I pushed https://github.com/bitcoin-core/qa-assets/commit/c62dc520e0c7caee3e50c9ba8a88056c7f4d357f to temporarily unbreak the CI.

It would be good if someone on Windows helped here to track this down.
@hodlinator Thanks! When the evaluation order isn't specified by the standard, it is unspecified. Mind submitting a fix?

Thanks a lot for checking @hodlinator!

According to https://timsong-cpp.github.io/cppwp/n4861/basic.exec#intro.execution-10:
> evaluations of operands of individual operators [...] are unsequenced. [...] If a side effect on a memory location [...] is unsequenced relative to [...] a value computation using the value of any object in the same memory location [...], the behavior is undefined

It seems that because the operands of `==` are unsequenced, side effects can lead to undefined behavior - my bad, it didn't even occur to me that this was UB - and makes me wonder how many other cases we have, if none of the linters were complaining.
@hodlinator I can push a PR with your email - I introduced the faulure, I should fix it.
Since I introduced the [idea](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/30746#discussion_r1817851827) to write the code like this, I'm happy to be part of resolving it. And happy to review your PR.

I have opened https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/32141 - but still [can't fuzz properly on mac](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/32084#issuecomment-2752412513), so would appreciate if someone could run it for a few minutes (especially on Windows).
